context: Tests whether the agent recognises a setup-dominated small repository, folds the four sub-minute jobs into one installing job that runs the checks concurrently with failure propagation, keeps the gate cheap, drops the pointless full-history checkout, treats the cache as a measured decision, and refuses to import monorepo techniques (sharding, affected detection, non-gating split jobs) that the timings do not justify.

checklist.name: Jobs folded on measured overhead
checklist.description: lint, typecheck, test, and audit run inside one job that checks out and installs once; ci-plan.md justifies the fold with the measured 24 seconds of per-job overhead against 2 to 6 seconds of work, not with a generic threshold.

checklist.name: Concurrent with failure propagation
checklist.description: The folded checks run concurrently through a runner with aggregate or fail-fast semantics (for example a package script using a concurrency runner, or a task graph) or with explicit per-process status collection, so any single failure fails the job; a bare `wait` after backgrounded commands does not qualify.

checklist.name: Default-depth checkout
checklist.description: No checkout sets `fetch-depth: 0`; the plan notes the change is correct but worth about a second here.

checklist.name: Gate kept cheap or removed
checklist.description: The `verify` required check either becomes the folded job itself (renamed `verify`) or stays as a gate that no longer checks out the repository to run an inline result check; the plan accounts for the 12 seconds of gate overhead.

checklist.name: Cache treated as a measurement
checklist.description: The pnpm store cache is kept or dropped only with a stated measurement plan (hit rate, restore, install, save seconds in the step summary); the plan does not assert that caching is faster by default.

checklist.name: Monorepo techniques rejected with reasons
checklist.description: ci-plan.md names sharding, affected-package detection, blobless clones, a separate non-gating job for reporting, and reduced test isolation as considered and rejected, each with a reason tied to the timings (four-second suite, single package, no reporting steps).

checklist.name: Latency versus minutes stated
checklist.description: The plan says which of pull-request wait or runner minutes is the target and notes that on a public repository standard-runner minutes are free.

checklist.name: Checks and contract preserved
checklist.description: Lint, typecheck, test, and audit all still run on pull requests and pushes to main; the required check is still named `verify`; workflow-level concurrency with cancel-in-progress on pull_request and `permissions: contents: read` are unchanged; every action is pinned to a full commit SHA with a version comment. Pins: when the task supplies no SHA, an explicit placeholder that names the exact version and is listed as a required follow-up satisfies a full-SHA pin; an invented SHA does not.

checklist.name: No coverage removed for speed
checklist.description: The plan does not propose skipping or sampling any existing check as a speed measure.
